title: Archive Linux 7 channel source audit with bounded static replay
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Preserve the closed Linux 7/AppArmor channel and original-contract source audit as a self-contained registered static replay in research/h25-c05-linux7-channel-audit. The source review did not accept a deployable channel mechanism and stopped **before any installer**. Full compiler-input closure and full bootstrap-control campaign remain false.

The package retains 25 selected kernel source/license/tag bodies at exact Ubuntu commit **88cb661f6b53f472167d39a72241b5396e34ab2a**, associated with tag Ubuntu-hwe-7.0-7.0.0-42.42_24.04.1 and source version 7.0.0-42.42~24.04.1. It retains all **54 selected AppArmor files / 843856 bytes**, plus the exact full **26432-byte LGPL-2.1 COPYING.LGPL** required by the retained libapparmor header, source controls, patch series, licenses, acquisition/limit failures, independent source reviews v1/v2, the 21-channel original-contract review and the late parser-qualification supplement. Kernel/package/tag association is distinct from complete signatures, source history and running-binary correspondence. AppArmor base source plus Debian/Ubuntu patch inputs remain **unapplied**; applied composition and the actual selected policy ABI remain **UNQUALIFIED**.

The finite source findings are:
- AppArmor's actual registered initializer contains getattr/file_receive but omits the reviewed inode_readlink, inode_permission and System V IPC families. Replay checks the initializer boundary and registration call. This is neither global string absence nor a universal impossibility result. Actual GCC use of a gap is not shown.
- Source transition/descriptor/rawlog facts leave original-preservation obligations: inherited FD revalidation/null replacement, unconfined object delegation, pdeath_signal and rlimit effects, ordinary nonappend rawlog opens, and unchanged direct Popen context. No actual log clobber or failed legitimate launch is demonstrated.
- BPF hook availability supplies no concrete complete policy, program/maps, attachment, authority or lifetime proof.
- Provider source has **216 runtime literal rows = 215 headers + /proc/self/exe**, plus one separately checked adjacent profile, producing the **217-file preflight**. Variant source explicitly requires **six C/header role occurrences** across two roles; it has no automatic all-215 child-membership loop. Provider custody does **not** establish compiler exclusion, a 215-row reduction, complete closure or fitting selection.

All original Python snapshots are inert .txt files and are parsed only as DATA. No archived C/Python source, historical test, original helper/provider/Root/caller/native TCB/compiler, namespace/Popen/scientific execution or policy installation runs.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessors: [PR #6374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6374), [PR #6373](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6373).

Exact publication base: **7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a**, tree **e6898c8ba7a27b71587c32ba3f639259ceeeed91**. TASK.json pins the portable-replay provenance card and declares **changed** scope for this explicit closed-source-evidence export; no random new task was drawn.

Nearest related deliveries:
- [PR6370](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6370), e144f3b0a440fd33efdcfa4e0bd1af059dfd4fb3
- [PR6371](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6371), 8e772eadcbdee11289eb2eac887ffc15b864587c
- [PR6373](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6373), b91c5c74f252c1a98ab8344d012702170004ed13
- [PR6374](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6374), b02bfe3338f7fe57818262b33f8e5c77ac0f1c93

These are related source/component packages; the added value here is the exact Linux 7/channel/215-header audit, its independent reviews and a cold-available static replay. Their supplied hosted PASS checkpoint observations are distinct from new exact-head publication checks and add zero original scientific credit. This bounded overlap list is not a novelty proof. No predecessor package is copied merely for provenance. All replay source bytes are local to this package; old local paths in raw evidence are historical origins, not execution dependencies.

## Validation

Observed local checks on the frozen export, Python 3.12 standard library:
- Metadata: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-linux7-channel-audit --check-only — PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS.
- Registered replay: python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-c05-linux7-channel-audit — normal and explicit -O commands pass, PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE, outcome partial.
- Package-only cold read-only copy: python3 -I -B verify.py and python3 -I -O -B verify.py — PASS_STATIC_SOURCE_AUDIT_ONLY in both profiles.

The verifier authenticates byte inventory/origins, exact acquisition/member/source pins, the actual hook array, transition/FD/rawlog source anchors, provider literal partition/separate preflight and variant two-role/six-file guard. Five pure DATA controls address unknown predicate, dangling reference, changed source pin, an out-of-array hook token and a changed registered hook. Inputs/source snapshots remain unchanged. Normal/optimized/cold agreement is reproducibility of this same static checker, not independent theorem or supplier acceptance.

Independent publication review rejected the preliminary packet for omitting the full LGPL-2.1 text referenced by a retained header. This successor adds the exact libraries/libapparmor/COPYING.LGPL member from the already pinned AppArmor original archive and its bounded DATA-only acquisition receipt. The preliminary packet and rejection remain preserved; original source/test bytes and all claims are unchanged.

Full compressed AppArmor archives and the private full kernel config are omitted; selected exact bytes, archive/member receipts and selected config facts/hash/size are retained. The unreviewed partial decoder/fixtures are excluded. Preparation failures/corrections and all raw validation outputs are preserved outside the package in the local export receipt; they are not silently counted as successful original work.

The original source gate remains unaccepted; the parser supplement is late append-only bookkeeping. The earlier source rounds remain closed. The application goal remains paused, guarded attempt unapproved. **94.550533479/2400 policy seconds are not complete physical cost; all outside costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO.** No fresh performance, kappa, complete original caller, original admission or scientific completion result is claimed. Hosted exact-head results are separate publication evidence.

Agent source review is not human or proof-kernel acceptance.

New checker/prose/metadata are Apache-2.0. Linux/AppArmor snapshots retain all original GPL/SPDX/copyright notices, complete selected license texts and source-specific exceptions; repository Apache-2.0 does not relicense them. See NOTICE.md, SOURCE-ORIGINS.json and retained license files.

## Open next questions

TASK.json has structured questions, relevance, smallest first steps and blockers. First qualify the complete applied parser composition/actual ABI, or one exact original-compatible alternative mechanism. Then close the whole 21-channel F/P/A/E/K/witness selection with original parent/FD/rawlog/native preservation and actual 512-row/wire/byte/resource fit. Independently admit the instance and complete all physical/funding/privilege/execution gates before any constructor. Hook absence alone does not rule out other sufficiently justified routes. These remain open and are not completed by static replay.
